name: LookOut
author: David Paluy
description: Break reminder. Counts down from your last break, then covers the screen for a short break. A minute without input counts as a break, and you can pause it. A break waits for a call or a playing video to end.

barWidget.description: Time to the next break, with a popup to start or postpone it.

schema.label: Seconds without input that count as a break
schema.description: When you do not touch the keyboard or mouse for this long, LookOut records a break and starts the countdown again when you come back. Not during a call.

schema.label: Wait for calls and videos
schema.description: A break that comes due during a call (microphone or camera) or while a browser or video player plays starts when it ends. The countdown does not stop.

schema.label: Allow skipping a break
schema.description: Shows Skip and +5 min on the break screen, and lets Esc skip.

schema.label: Apps that are not calls
schema.description: Comma-separated app or process names that record audio but are not calls, such as visualizers or dictation tools.
